overview: A fully on-chain planetary warfare strategy game where players purchase hex plots, generate tokens, fire weapons, and compete for global dominance on ICP.
features: Purchase hex plot territories on an interactive 3D globe
Passive FRNTR token generation per owned plot
4-hour sub-parcel unlock cooldown after plot purchase
Artillery and missile combat with cinematic 2D battle view
Commander NFT assignment with rank-based buffs
Resource mining (Iron, Fuel, Crystal, Rare Earth) by biome
